text:
deploy-bot: Started rollout: service/embedder:v2.3.1 -> prod. Canary 10% -> 12:05 UTC. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/embedder-deploy

maria: Kicking off canary now. I'll monitor SLO dashboard + logs. Sam, Lia — can you watch p50/p95/p99 and 5xx/429s?

sam: Oncall here. I'll keep a 5m watch window and mute noisy alerts. Setting alert window to 5m now.

lia: Seeing an uptick on kvcache errors in eu-west1 right after shift. Quick tail from canary pods:
```
[2026-06-14T12:07:33Z] ERROR embedder[kvcache] MissRate=12.3% shard=a03 GET key=... latency=12ms
[2026-06-14T12:07:35Z] WARN  client 429 response from kvproxy
```

dennis: 5xx rate at canary hitting 0.8% over last 3m, threshold we agreed was 0.5% for pause/rollback. @maria recommend pausing ramp and pinning back to stable in eu-west.

maria: Pausing ramp. Will pin EU canary to stable until triage complete. Command I'll run: `/deploy pin service/embedder v2.3.0 --scope eu-west1`

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused. Pin applied: service/embedder -> v2.3.0 for eu-west1 (canary).

ryan: Heads-up — v2.3.1 includes fused-attn kernel selection on A10s which can change KV cache touch patterns. Could explain the extra 429s. We can try toggling feature flag before full rollback. Lower blast radius.

lia: Agree. Can we flip `use_fused_attn=false` for prod-canary and observe?

maria: Doing flag toggle now: `cfg set service/embedder use_fused_attn=false --env prod-canary`

deploy-bot: Flag update accepted. Restarting canary pods (3 replicas) with new config.

sam: Watching metrics — p95 trending down after flag flip. 5xx now 0.23% over last 2m. Logs show reduced KV proxy 429s.

observability-bot: Alert cleared: 5xx <= 0.5% for 5m for service/embedder (canary eu-west1).

maria: Good recovery. Proposal: keep canary pinned at 10% for 30m to validate and then continue to 30% if stable. No global rollout until we confirm stability for 30m. Thoughts? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

sam: +1 from me. Keep close eye on p99 and error budget.

dry: (typo)

dennis: I'll add a short incident note to the release doc and capture the kernel/flag correlation, plus a follow-up action to add a smoke check that exercises kvcache paths during preflight.

maria: Noted. Release notes snippet for v2.3.1: "Temporarily disable fused-attn on A10-backed canaries due to kv-proxy 429 regression; follow-up kernel tuning planned." Commit sha: `a1b2c3d4`.

maria: Closing this thread for now. I'll re-open if anything regresses during the 30m hold. Thanks everyone.
